title: SYNTHESIS GATE (frontier): schema design requirements from research items 1-3 - unlocks the build
description: The brief's hard gate: 'Schema design may begin once items 1-3 are synthesized; items 4-7 refine it' (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:57). Consume docs/precedent-research/01-stare-decisis-mechanics.md, 02-ratio-identification.md and 03-overruling-doctrines.md and produce the single document the build consumes: docs/precedent-research/synthesis-design-requirements.md - the PR record schema, the authority-tier ladder as implemented, the CLI surface, and the explicit non-duplication contract. This is low-verifiability judgment work and stays at frontier tier per P-030 (ORCHESTRATION.md:147-160). No source edits (thinker role): this task writes exactly one file and publishes no code.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE: docs/precedent-research/synthesis-design-requirements.md. No source edits, no .harness/bin/ writes, no PRECEDENT.md. Thinker role.

EVERY requirement is CITED to the research document and section that produced it (requirement -> 02-ratio-identification.md section N). A requirement with no research citation is either dropped or explicitly labelled 'planner judgment, no research basis'.

FIXES THE PR RECORD SCHEMA: the complete field list with types, required/optional, and - load-bearing - which fields are AUTHOR-DECLARED and bind on publication versus which are VERIFIER-CONFIRMED and do NOT bind until confirmed. The corpus finding this must honour: author-declared benefit attribution is roughly trustworthy (about 5x random) while author-declared scope of harm is not (about 2x random) - papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:9 section 4.4.2. Therefore ratio may be author-declared; SCOPE CONDITIONS AND BLAST RADIUS MUST NOT BIND until a verifier confirms them, and the schema must make the unconfirmed state mechanically distinguishable (not a convention).

FIXES the authority-tier ladder exactly as it will be implemented, each tier keyed to a mechanically observable fact per coordinator decision D4 (1 operator gate fired or operator directive recorded; 2 NLAH mutation accepted via the section 5A loop plus human gate; 3 a producer-distinct-from-approver verdict exists on the issuing task; 4 a DECISION: note that never passed a verifier - persuasive only). If research items 1-3 overrule any tier boundary, say so and record the overruling.

FIXES the citation ID format PR-NNN per coordinator decision D3, and what a citation may point at: PR-NNN, task IDs T-xxx, agent identity, harness generation, events.jsonl timestamps. The Claude hook session_id is explicitly rejected as an anchor (ephemeral, single-engine).

MANDATORY non-duplication contract (this is the acceptance criterion the corpus finding demands): for EVERY new field and verb, name the existing record it EXTENDS - the note taxonomy (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), the P-number ledger (state.json evolution.accepted_mutations), the reopen verb (.harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517), events.jsonl, recontext.py - and state what verification work the precedent layer MUST NOT re-do. Anything that would duplicate existing verification is either dropped or reduced to a pointer at the existing record. Rationale: measured non-additive interaction, papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8 Table 3 RQ3a and p.9. State the CHECK the verifier will run to confirm non-duplication (for example: no new log file is created, precedent records reference the issuing task's existing verdict instead of re-recording it, PRECEDENT.md cites ORCHESTRATION.md rules rather than restating them).

FIXES the CLI surface for T-340: subcommand names, flags, exit-code contract, the registry root override required so tests never write the live registry (both T-342 and T-343 need this - F1), and guarded monotonic PR-NNN allocation via harness_common.guarded() so two concurrent publishes cannot collide. Constraint to respect: stdlib only, must run under the bare python3 in this environment (3.9.6 - no match statement, no tomllib at module scope, no dataclass slots).

DECISION note required on coordinator decision D1's provisional sub-decision (author declares the ratio at write time): CONFIRMED or OVERRULED, citing T-331's verdict. If overruled, this epic records its own first overruling - which is the mechanism the epic is building.

MUST list what is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for v0, so no downstream worker invents it: full retrofit of all ~30 P-numbers (follow-on, gated on the schema surviving adversarial verification - D2), conflict detection as a hard gate (D6 says on-demand pass), any mutation of claude.md/gemini.md (NLAH mutation, section 5A loop plus human gate - ORCHESTRATION.md:225-229), any write to state.json including backfilling evolution.accepted_mutations (tier-2 constitutional act, escalated by T-343 not performed), and anything from Part III or Part IV.

Hand off to role verifier with a note listing the field-by-field schema decision table. Verification tier: doc/contract tier - the verifier checks internal consistency, citation coverage, the author-declared vs verifier-confirmed split, and the non-duplication contract; the real adversarial test is T-346 replaying the built CLI against this document.

notes.note: DECISION: T-339 claimed by thinker-synthesis. Inputs read in full: 01/02/03 research docs, coordinator memo D1-D8, corpus grounding report, synthesis-refinements (T-344). Output: docs/precedent-research/synthesis-design-requirements.md only. No source edits (thinker).

DECISION: D1 provisional sub-decision (author declares the ratio at write time) is CONFIRMED, citing T-331's verdict (02 §3 "CONFIRM, with a load-bearing qualification"): structural declaration settles PRESENCE (ratio required, non-empty, binds at tier on publication) but never WIDTH; width lives in scope_conditions/declared_width bound by a confirmation lifecycle only a distinct identity may flip. No self-overruling recorded this epic.

FIELD-BY-FIELD SCHEMA DECISION TABLE (class A = author-declared, binds at publication; W = author-written, binds only after verifier confirmation; R = registry-maintained, never author-settable):
- id PR-NNN, R, CLI-minted under hc.guarded(), monotonic (D3; SDR-19)
- schema_version int=1, R (planner judgment)
- title str<=80, A (planner judgment); subject slug, A (board T-342 detector 1)
- status enum active|overruled|superseded|void_per_incuriam, R (03 §6.1/F4; T-340 AC-6; 01 F4 adds void_per_incuriam)
- authority_tier 1-4 + tier_evidence citation tokens, A but replay-checkable (D4; 01 per-tier observability bullets; per-tier required token kind: tier1 event:/T-NNN, tier2 P-NNN, tier3 T-NNN, tier4 T-NNN)
- ratio str required, A, BINDS on publication (02 §4-§5, C-1 ~5x class); dicta list, A, explicitly non-binding (01 §5)
- scope_conditions list (req. tiers 1-3) + declared_width narrow|wide, W, DO NOT BIND until confirmed (C-1 ~2x class; 02 §4-§5); unconfirmed state mechanical: confirmation_status=unconfirmed AND confirmed_by=null (T-340 AC-6)
- confirmation_status unconfirmed|confirmed|narrowed|rejected + confirmed_by/confirmed_at/narrowed_scope/confirmation_note, R, flipped only by precedent.py confirm with acting agent != published_by (02 §5, 02 Implications 3; P-011 authorship logic reused)
- revisit_trigger str required tiers 1-3, A (T-344 S-12; 07 Impl. 1; 08 §8.1)
- relations[] {type follows|distinguishes|overrules|supersedes|voids, target, distinguishing_facts, factors[], factor_note, controlling_authority, below_target_tier}, A, immutable (T-344 floor generalized to a list; 01 F4; 03 F1)
- cites[] tokens PR/T/P/gen/agent/event/path:line, A (D3; session_id REJECTED per D3); cited_by[], R, publish side effect (03 F2)
- overruled_by/superseded_by/voided_by, R (T-340 AC-6); issuing_task/published_by/published_at, A/R (D3)
CLI: publish/show/list/cite/confirm; conflicts RESERVED for T-342, merge RESERVED for the operator gate (T-344 R-12). Exit codes 0 ok / 1 refusal / 2 usage / 3 findings / 4 registry integrity. --root flag + PRECEDENT_ROOT env on every verb (flag wins; T-340 AC-5, plan Q7). Events: 9 new kinds via hc.log_event into existing events.jsonl, no new log file (C-2).

THE 3 HARDEST DESIGN CALLS:
1. DECISION (SDR-07): tier-3 overruling requires EQUAL adversarial weight, not a wider quorum. 01 F3 posed the en-banc question; resolved Young-exception-1/Practice-Statement style, reinforced by the Mexican decoupling (03 §4: replacement re-clears full formation rules, which publish --overrules structurally forces). Cost accepted: one verdicted pair can undo one verdicted pair; no multi-verifier primitive invented (C-2). Presented to operator at T-348.
2. TRADEOFF (SDR-19 vs 03 §6.1): every bindingness transition (overrule/supersede/void) flows through publish of a successor record inside one guarded block, rather than the standalone overrule verb 03 proposed. Gains atomicity (status flip + cited_by side effects + successor mint cannot diverge) and a uniform data model for T-342; cost is diverging from 03's proposed verb shape - its four reopen-pattern invariants (mandatory reasoning, narrow preconditions, event log, clean transition) are all preserved inside the publish path. Scope confirmation is the single sanctioned in-place mutation.
3. DECISION (SDR-04): tier-3 bindingness is role-scoped, never identity-scoped - scope_conditions may bind roles/paths/tiers, never a reassignable agent identity string (01 headline finding 1: real horizontal precedent binds the office, not the person). Enforced as a verifier protocol rule at confirmation, not a parser (T-344 R-6 semantic/structural split; C-2).

Also load-bearing: SDR-12 makes citation resolution non-blocking on dangling cites/tier_evidence (warn + dangling_reference event) specifically so T-343's P-023 seed can RECORD the live ledger gap instead of being refused for naming it; relations[].target dangling is still a refusal. SDR-18 ships T-344's S-09 check inside publish as subject-key match, mandatory-but-non-blocking (D6 extended, not overruled).

VERIFICATION TIER: doc/contract (P-024). Replay guide is section 10 of the artifact: internal consistency, SDR citation coverage (grep "planner judgment": every hit must be convention-level, never doctrine-level), the A/W/R split against C-1, the non-duplication contract (SDR-28/29/30 checks runnable as written), T-344 floor reconciliation (section 7 asserts NO T-344 verdict flips to DEFERRED - verify against T-344 §0). The real adversarial test is T-346 replaying the built CLI against this document.

DECISION: T-339 verification claimed by verifier-synthesis. Tier: control-plane doc/contract, FULL replay per P-024 (this gate unlocks T-340..T-348). Plan: read the artifact plus all four mandated inputs in full (01/02/03, D1-D8 memo, T-344 synthesis-refinements, corpus-grounding report, context brief, plan.md precedent-layer section); then five checks: (1) citation coverage - every SDR traces to a research section, D-decision, T-344 item or board AC, or is labelled planner judgment, and every planner-judgment label is convention-level not doctrine-level; (2) D-decision fidelity - D1 explicit publication, D3 PR-NNN plus session_id rejection, D4 four tiers keyed to observable facts, D5 placement, D6 conflicts reserved for T-342; (3) the C-1 reliability asymmetry encoded mechanically (ratio binds, scope waits, unconfirmed state is a field state not a convention); (4) the non-duplication contract (existing verdicts referenced, existing events.jsonl, no new log, no parallel locking) with its checks runnable as written; (5) CLI surface implementable by T-340 without judgment calls. Substrate claims are replayed against live code and state, not trusted.

CHECK 1 - CITATION COVERAGE / NO FABRICATED RIGOR: PASS. All 30 SDR requirements plus all 26 field-table rows and all 7 relation-object rows carry a citation to a research section, a D-decision, a T-344 register item, or a board acceptance criterion, or are labelled "planner judgment, no research basis". Twelve "planner judgment" labels found by grep (schema_version, title length, subject slug format, tier-4 scope optionality, P-NNN token addition, --agent default, exit-code numbering, publish stdout line, --subject/--json filters, one event kind instead of two, title/subject validation): every one is convention-level (naming, formats, numbers), none is doctrine-level. Roughly 35 substantive citations were spot-checked against the source text and all are accurate, including the load-bearing ones: 02 section 3's verdict wording "CONFIRM, with a load-bearing qualification"; 02 Implications 5's "one field at a time, rather than the whole record moving as a unit" (verbatim); 01 headline finding 1's "a real schema decision T-339 has not yet made and should not default silently" (verbatim, answered by SDR-04); 01 F1's lower-tier-refusal demand (correctly translated to "tier number GREATER than target" in SDR-17.8); 01 F3's en-banc question (answered by SDR-07 and forwarded to T-348 as F3 itself instructs); 01 F4 (void_per_incuriam); 03 F1/F2 (factor recitation mandatory at tier 3, cited_by as a write-time side effect); 03 section 2's "a factor-recitation rule buys auditability, not correctness"; 03 section 4's art. 228/229 decoupling; 03 section 5's four per-tier rows; 03 section 7/F6 (rank-vs-rigor, correctly forwarded not reopened); 03 section 6.1's four reopen properties; T-344 C-1/C-2, R-1, R-6, R-11, R-12, R-14c and S-01 through S-13.

The A/W/R class column implements it: ratio and dicta are class A and bind on publication (~5x class); scope_conditions and declared_width are class W and do not bind until confirmed (~2x class). The unconfirmed state is a field state, not a convention: confirmation_status == "unconfirmed" AND confirmed_by == null (SDR-02), forced at publish regardless of input (SDR-17.15), flippable only by an agent whose identity differs from published_by (SDR-24.1, reusing P-011's authorship-governs logic at blackboard.py:14-28 rather than adding a gate), rendered explicitly by show and list (SDR-21), four-valued so a verifier can narrow without rejecting (field 13), with narrowed_scope written by the reviewer instead of editing the author's text (SDR-01 immutability). SDR-02's "an unconfirmed scope claim carries tier-4 strength even on a tier-1 record" is the correct reading of 02 section 4 and is exactly what T-346 AC-3c will attack. Corpus numbers verified against .harness/corpus-grounding-precedent-layer.md section 2 (33.7/51.4 vs 11.8/11.1, papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:9 section 4.4.2) - transcribed correctly.

CHECK 4 - NON-DUPLICATION CONTRACT: PASS. DEFECTS RECORDED (none blocking; all logged for the named downstream consumer rather than sent back, because each is a label or a one-step-downstream clarification, not a wrong or unimplementable decision):
D-1. DEVIATION (citation label, 3 occurrences - lines 90, 131, 345): "03 R-4.4 via T-344" mislabels the source document. R-numbers exist only in T-344; R-4 item 4 (Chenery, contemporaneous reasons at publication) traces to 06 section 5 via T-344, and document 03 contains no Chenery discussion. The attributed content is accurate and the "via T-344" pointer makes it findable, and the ratio requirement is independently cited to 02 section 5/section 4/Implications 4, so the requirement remains traceable with the mislabel struck - which is why this is a hygiene defect and not the fabricated-rigor class that rejected T-332 round 1. Correct label: "T-344 R-4.4 (06 section 5, Chenery)". T-348's audit sweep should carry the correction.
D-2. Inherited inaccuracy: field 14's rationale (and SDR-28's confirmation-lifecycle row) says decided_by/decided_at come from evolution.accepted_mutations. Verified live: accepted_mutations entries carry id/target/summary/status/gate/applied_note/applied_at; decided_by/decided_at live on evolution.pending_proposals. The error originates in 02 section 5 and is inherited verbatim. Zero build impact (the shipped names are confirmed_by/confirmed_at and the ledger is read-only here), but T-341 must not repeat it.
D-3. Inherited stale line citation: SDR-12 cites state.json:791 for the P-023 gen-5 backlog note; the note is now at state.json:836 (line 791 is P-029's summary). Origin is context brief section 2.4, and T-342 AC-2 and T-343 AC-3 carry the same number. Actionable for T-343: SDR-10's path:lines token resolves only "the file exists", so a stale line number will NOT be caught by the resolver - the seed record must be checked against the line's content at publish time.
D-4. Spec gap (minor, resolvable from the stated contract): the exit code for "PR-NNN not found" on show / confirm / cite --record is not stated explicitly. SDR-15's code 1 ("a named precondition failed") is the only consistent reading and code 4 is reserved for unparseable records, so T-340 should use 1 and T-341 should document it.
D-5. Spec gap (one step downstream): after confirmation_status == narrowed, the document does not state in words that narrowed_scope is the operative scope and scope_conditions is superseded, though SDR-01 plus SDR-02 plus field 16 imply exactly that. T-342's scope-overlap detector (AC-2 detector 4) needs the answer; T-341 should state it.
D-6. Coverage gap in the research-to-requirement direction: 02 section 6's two overreach detectors (signal 1, the evidence-footprint/Wambaugh inversion check against the issuing task's artifacts; signal 2, the D4 tier-mismatch check comparing a record's self-claimed reach against its own computed tier) are assigned by 02 Implications 6 to T-342 and T-344, but T-344's inputs were items 4-8 only, so it never saw them, and this synthesis does not forward them. The schema does provide every field both signals need, so nothing is lost structurally - but unless T-342 is told, no task in the DAG picks them up. Recommend the coordinator add them to T-342's detector list (its AC-2 says "at minimum") and that T-348 record the routing gap. Signal 2 is also the partial mitigation for the residual self-elevation risk noted below.
D-7. Presentation, not substance: the three hardest design calls are disclosed in the handoff note (SDR-07's equal-weight overruling, SDR-19's folding of 03 F4's proposed standalone overrule verb into publish, SDR-04's role-not-identity scoping) but only the first and third are argued inside the artifact. The document does preserve reopen's invariants inside the publish path (SDR-17.10/17.11/17.12 plus SDR-19.5) and SDR-28 states the pattern extension, so T-341 will document publish --overrules rather than an overrule verb and T-346's cross-check stays sound; the TRADEOFF is on the replayable task record either way.

RESIDUAL RISK ACCEPTED AND NAMED (not a defect - the design discloses it): tier_evidence is required in KIND but its resolution is non-blocking (SDR-12), so a record can self-declare tier 1 or 2 with a dangling token and publish. This is load-bearing, not laxity: T-343's P-023 seed exists precisely to record a tier-2 record whose ledger evidence is missing, and a refusing publish could never record the defect the layer exists to catch. The compensating controls are stated (dangling_reference event, T-342 detector 5, unverifiable-tier weighting left to verifier judgment) and 02 section 6 signal 2 would add the tier-mismatch detector (see D-6). T-346 and T-347 should attack forged tier_evidence explicitly.
